data.one_liner: Integrate Storyblok headless CMS with your Flutter app.
data.what_it_does: Provides an SDK for the Storyblok Content Delivery API to fetch stories, datasources, and links. It also works with a code generator for type-safe serializing.
use_when: You are using Storyblok as the headless CMS for your Flutter application.
You want to fetch stories and content dynamically using the Storyblok API.
avoid_when: You are using a different CMS provider than Storyblok.
strengths: Supports exhaustiveness checking and automatic, type-safe serializing when used with the code generator.
Includes support for regions outside of the EU.
weaknesses: Relies on a separate code generator package for full type safety.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and optionally use the code generator package.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer making direct raw HTTP REST requests to the Storyblok API instead of using a dedicated SDK wrapper.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a robust HTTP client with interceptors and advanced networking features to query Storyblok manually.
